regeln: Show authentic tool interfaces and source-supported interface views directly instead of replacing them with avatars, logos, or symbolic illustrations.
Use 3-5 seconds of a distinct, relevant visual motif for each spoken segment in Shorts; long videos may have longer demonstrations but must still align tightly with narration.
A new motif must be a genuinely different visual; zooms, crops, subtitle changes, decorative backgrounds, or minor label tweaks do not count.
Introduce the correct channel presenter at the opening and bring them back for useful actions throughout without substituting them with unrelated characters.
Include the mandatory spoken CTA at the format-specific position and never replace it with a different call-to-action.
Place all on-screen text, captions, and overlays within the inner title-safe zone with sufficient padding to avoid clipping or overlap.
Maintain factual accuracy by avoiding unsupported specifications, performance guarantees, or invented details and resolve any warnings first.
Vary visual pacing by avoiding prolonged static shots and switch to dynamic, relevant visuals that illustrate the narration.
Craft a clear narrative arc by opening with a compelling hook, developing the explanation, and providing a concrete, source-backed answer before the CTA.
For AI-Tools Explained, name each tool briefly then show authentic interface views and source-supported examples while avoiding generic stock.
Use the channel's original painted open-world aesthetic consistently for backgrounds and branding while ensuring each motif adds narrative value.
Include a brief, source-supported walkthrough that visually demonstrates the described benefit whenever a script calls for a concrete example or demo.

produktionsdiagnosen.quelle: GitHub-Produktionsbericht, Skript und Joblog; kein Nutzerqualitaetsurteil
befunde: Generatives Sprachmodell und nicht-generative Entscheidungsmodelle wurden unter Hallucination-Free AI zusammengefasst.
Faktenpruefer verwarfen mehrere Story-Ueberarbeitungen wegen unbelegter Detail-/Hardwareaussagen.
Im gespeicherten Entwurf bleibt single forward pass als unbelegter Detailhinweis stehen.
Der Kritiker schlug eine neue Null-Halluzinations-Garantie und andere Tools vor; diese Vorschlaege sind keine Quellen.
Kein Video erzeugt, keine Video-Note und keine Telegram-Videozustellung.
